public_rationale: Strong performance in chess, Go and the tested Diplomacy setting is supported. The unrestricted claim of never succeeding in unpredictable dynamic environments is contradicted by successful real-world balloon control under uncertain winds. That example does not establish competence in war or unrestricted adaptation. A narrower reading about wholly unforeseen changes would therefore require a different assessment.
limitations: The distinction between environmental uncertainty and unrestricted task change affects the result.
The balloon controller performed a bounded task.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Special-purpose AI has been great for static, easily simulated games with rules that have been stable for centuries, such as chess, Go and even Diplomacy, but has never been great at dynamic environments in which the environment itself is unpredictable.
conditions: static, easily-simulated games with rules that have been stable for centuries
dynamic environments in which the environment itself is unpredictable

statement.excerpt: Special-purpose AI has been great for static, easily-simulated games with rules that have been stable for centuries, like Chess, Go, and even Diplomacy, but never been great at dynamic environments in which the environment itself is unpredictable.

from_speaker: rules that have been stable for centuries

our_interpretation: Great means strong demonstrated performance against capable humans or an established operational baseline.
The positive game-performance assertion and the negative assertion about unpredictable environments are assessed separately.
Unpredictability must involve material uncertainty in the environment itself. Hidden opponent actions in an otherwise fixed simulator are not sufficient by themselves.
Special-purpose includes systems trained for a particular task even when their underlying learning algorithm is general.
Has been and never refer to the historical record through publication, with no stated lower date.
criteria.support_condition: Strong performance in the named games is established, while a sufficiently broad historical record supports the absence of strong performance in dynamic environments with material external uncertainty.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A pre-publication system demonstrates strong performance in a materially unpredictable dynamic environment. Evidence against the rule-history wording would separately contradict that component.

evidence.explanation: The report describes task-trained AlphaZero systems achieving superhuman chess and Go performance and defeating champion programs. This supports the positive game-performance component.

Meta reports that CICERO exceeded the human average score and ranked in the top tenth of participants who played more than one game. This supports strong performance in the tested online Diplomacy setting.

evidence.locator: Abstract, Autonomous navigation of stratospheric balloons using reinforcement learning
evidence.explanation: The study describes real-world balloon control despite forecast errors and sparse wind measurements, including a controlled field experiment. Strong performance under those external uncertainties contradicts the unrestricted never assertion.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A stated meaning of unpredictable would settle the scope dispute. Separate historical evidence items would complete the assessment of the centuries-long rule-history wording.
